description: Changes a plugin: name, settings (whole), patch (merged), form_html, status active or paused, or recipients {add: email} (an extra inbox for every site on the plan). A changed form or booking setup returns setup_summary first; a new inbox or AI-set reply_to_email, approve_url.

lang.description: The page's <html lang>, e.g. de (one snippet per language)

patch.description: Merged onto the settings, e.g. {"approval":"always"}; null removes a key, arrays are replaced

settings.description: The whole object, as list_plugins settings_help (forms too)

name: update_plugin
title: Change a plugin
